title: Time of Session High
summary: How often the session's high printed within the first m minutes (default: the first hour). The denominator is every session with a resolved high time; the numerator is the ones whose first print of the high came before the cutoff. The real payload is the attached minutes-to-high distribution over ALL eligible sessions: the threshold rate is one slice of it, and moving the cutoff re-slices without re-deriving anything.

params.name: within
params.doc: Cutoff from the session open, in minutes.

deltas: the full time-of-high distribution, not a single early-or-late percentage
the cutoff is a parameter: first 15, 30, 60, 90 minutes are one preset
condition on gap or event days to see when the high clock shifts
